runtime_parameter_rules.stage_selection: m_Enabled AND non-null m_Prefab. Choose a single area branch by caster side with fallback, never both.
runtime_parameter_rules.location: location_enums.json and SpellUtils 0x06014ab8/0x06014ad0/0x06014ad2. SOURCE_AUTO of spell resolves controller hero; HERO_POWER resolves power card; NONE preserves prefab position.
runtime_parameter_rules.missile_time: Random.Range(PathDurationMin,Max) directly assigned iTween time. Distance does not rescale time.
runtime_parameter_rules.missile_center: mid=source+(target-source)*CenterOffsetPercent*.01. distanceScale=distance/DistanceScaleFactor; multiply height and sideways offsets only. Zero-distance special height +2 if configured heights <=epsilon.
runtime_parameter_rules.missile_joint: FindChildBySubstring(missile.gameObject,TargetJoint). If found LookAt root to target using JointUpVector, add TargetHeightOffset to final Y, MoveTo child. Otherwise MoveTo root with no height addition.
runtime_parameter_rules.randomness: Visual path/random-wait draws are separate from rules target/discard RNG. Preserve correlated per-gate draws.
runtime_parameter_rules.spell_finish: SpellFinishAction immediately Finish()s action; its delayed OnSpellFinished callback does not gate FSM transition.
runtime_parameter_rules.null_property: FsmProperty.SetValue0x060001f5 returns for null cachedTarget. Do not retarget null objects by property name.
runtime_parameter_rules.particle_events: SpellStateAnimObject.Play starts referenced clips; AnimationEvents dispatch PlayNewParticles methods. ParticleSystem.Play() defaults withChildren=true.
runtime_parameter_rules.runtime_boundary: These source routines require coordinate projection, material/RT, and original mesh ownership adapters. Source timing evidence is not a claim of pixel-identical Unity execution.
